# Academic Reading

Fourteen original Academic-style passages, from Passage 1 level (Band 5.5–6.5) to Passage 3 level (Band 7–8), covering every Reading question type.

**Each folder contains** `passage.md` · `questions.json` (auto-graded) · `QUESTIONS.md` · `SOLUTION.md` (explanations, evidence quotes, traps) · `meta.json`.

**Timing:** 20 minutes per passage. Three passages in a row = one full 60-minute Reading test. Suggested full tests: **01 + 04 + 06**, **02 + 03 + 07**, **05 + 08 + 11**, **09 + 10 + 14**, **12 + 13 + 11**.
